decisions.decision: Design gate CONFIRMED. Four nullable DOUBLE PRECISION _calc columns, the self-join backfill migration, no new index. Also confirmed: a missing raw reading on one wheel makes that wheel's delta NULL, not all four.
decisions.why: User answered both gate questions. Projection-only columns need no index; a 0.0 delta already means 'no change', so it must not also mean 'unknown'.

decisions.decision: Restored the migration-backfill DB-integration test (B.8) that the artifact worker had cut. The Recalculate and LatestMetricsByAccount tests stay cut.
decisions.why: RD8 bans cosmetic markup tests, not SQL tests. Tier 1's same test failed first run and found a real migration-order bug. The self-join predicate is new SQL nothing else runs.

decisions.decision: Corrected design.md Fixture 6's expected FR delta from 0.9 to 4.9. The worker asserted 4.9 in the test and flagged the mismatch.
decisions.why: The fixture's own inputs give 40.1 - 35.2 = 4.9. The prose was a typo. Left uncorrected, the reviewer would read the test as breaking the contract.

decisions.decision: The leader fixed kkpa/context/use-case/gateway/read-dashboard-bento.md, which C.3 found stale. It said four VehicleStatus fields are unread by the gateway; it is now eight.
decisions.why: The file is a gateway guide, outside the analytics worker's sandbox. CLAUDE.md requires the KB to be fixed in the same change that invalidates it.

review.brief: Review commits 5a417c1 and 7f668e0 on ft/RM50-MAG-56-vehicle-status-subsections against openspec/changes/RM50-analytics-add-tire-pressure-variance/{design.md,specs/analytics/spec.md,tasks.md}. Check: (1) every DB object matches the user-confirmed gate design -- four nullable DOUBLE PRECISION _calc columns, self-join backfill, NO new index; any mismatch is a blocker finding. (2) D2's two independent NULL conditions hold in Go AND in the backfill SQL. (3) The integration and unit tests assert design.md's Test Contract fixtures, not whatever the implementation happens to do. Note: the leader corrected a real typo in Fixture 6 (FR delta 0.9 -> 4.9, derived from the fixture's own inputs) -- verify that correction is right and that no OTHER expected value was bent to fit the code. (4) Module-boundary compliance: nothing outside internal/analytics except the two doc files. (5) Doc-pack conventions: unit suffixes, no raw time.Now, never-fabricate pointer rules. (6) Anti-gaming: no weakened or deleted acceptance criteria, no self-approved status. (7) Docs track structural change, including the KB. SIGNAL PROVENANCE: go build, go vet, gofmt, migration-guard, boundary-guard and archive-guard were ASSISTANT-run and clean. The test suite was run by the OWNER, who reported `make test` passing. Do NOT run the suite yourself. Judge test quality by reading the tests.

rounds.notes: Doc pack read: CLAUDE.md, ai/architecture.md, ai/go-conventions.md, ai/agentic-workflow.md, internal/analytics/AGENTS.md. Change artifacts read: design.md, specs/analytics/spec.md, tasks.md, proposal.md, progress.json. Diffs read in full: git show 5a417c1, git show 7f668e0. (1) DB gate: migration 20260908000003 adds exactly four nullable DOUBLE PRECISION columns, self-join backfill, no index change -- matches design.md and the D-gate decision exactly. Re-verified with make migration-guard (clean, pre-existing unrelated warning only). (2) D2 two-condition NULL rule verified in consumption.go (tpmsDeltaPSI returns nil if either operand nil), consumed.go (four fields left unset in the predecessor-less branch), and the backfill SQL (join miss leaves NULL; Postgres NULL arithmetic leaves NULL per missing wheel). No 0.0 fabrication anywhere. (3) Test Contract fidelity: consumption_test.go and consumed_test.go assert exactly the fixture values from design.md (Fixture 1/3/4/5/6), including the corrected Fixture 6 FR delta. Verified 40.1-35.2=4.9 by hand; FL/RL/RR unchanged and correct (5.0/5.1/5.0). No other expected value was altered. The new DB-integration test (db_tpms_variance_migration_integration_test.go) asserts hand-computed deltas from its own seeded fixtures, not implementation-derived values. (4) Boundaries: git show --stat on both commits touches only internal/analytics/*, this change's own openspec artifacts, and the two documentation files named in the brief. Re-verified with make boundary-guard (clean) and make archive-guard (clean, no archived file touched). (5) Conventions: unit suffix _psi_calc correct; no raw time.Now introduced; pointer fields never defaulted, reuse pgFloat8FromPtr/ptrFloat64FromPg per design.md's 'no new mapping code' instruction. Re-ran go build ./..., go vet ./internal/analytics/..., gofmt -l internal/analytics -- all clean. (6) Anti-gaming: tasks.md checkboxes match actual committed work; spec.md was not touched by these two commits (created earlier, not edited to fit); the only 'edit' to a pre-existing artifact is the design.md Fixture 6 typo fix, which is arithmetically correct and recorded as decision D-fixture6. review.status was untouched by the worker/leader. (7) Docs: internal/analytics/AGENTS.md and kkpa/context/entities/vehicle-metrics/guide.md updated with the four new columns/fields and the opposite-NULL-rule note. C.3's grep sweep correctly found and the leader fixed the stale bento use-case guide (4 unread fields -> 8). Spot-checked kkpa/context/use-case/gateway/read-dashboard-history.md, which references vehicle_metrics/VehicleStatus but enumerates no field list this change would invalidate -- not stale.
